rationale: The plan fits the paired design exactly: DESeq2 with ~ subject + condition, subject as a factor blocking term, explicit control reference level and (condition, treated, control) contrast, with an edgeR QL refit on the identical blocked design as a robustness check. QC precedes the model with library sizes, size factors, blind VST, PCA and distance heatmap labelled by subject and condition, a pairing integrity check, and a stated flag-don't-drop policy, though the downstream handling of a flagged outlier or shallow sample is left slightly open. Filtering is minimal and justified (>=10 counts in >=5 samples plus independent filtering), normalization is internal median-of-ratios/TMM with an explicit ban on pre-normalized inputs, BH at alpha 0.05 with apeglm shrinkage and lfcThreshold-in-test are all stated, enrichment is correctly omitted, and the report spec includes method, design, contrast, thresholds, counts tested and DE, sessionInfo, and the 5-pair power and df caveats.
